submitted.rationale: EQE by Sb fraction: 0.266 gave 0.116%, 0.415 gave 0.333%, 0.450 gave 0.325%, 0.661 gave 0.017% and 0.788 gave 0.012%. I fitted a log-parabola to the first three scouting points and it predicted a peak near Sb≈0.415. Measuring index 11 there gave the highest value. XRD shows the same single rutile-type phase at Sb 0.35 and 0.45. At Sb 0.55 extra peaks appear (Q≈2.46, 3.65), which suggests a second phase and fits the performance drop at higher Sb.

rejected.reason: XRD shows a second phase starting and EQE collapses
